name: Foxden
author: Louis Collins
short_desc: Self-hosted Firefox Sync server — bookmarks, history, passwords and tabs, end-to-end encrypted, for Firefox and Zen Browser.
description: Foxden is a self-hosted Firefox Sync server for a household or small group. It replaces every Mozilla service that Sync uses with one Docker container and one SQLite database. Stock Firefox and Zen Browser work without add-ons or custom builds. Your bookmarks, history, passwords and tabs stay on a server you control, and nothing depends on Mozilla's servers. Accounts are invite-only (user and admin roles), the sync payload stays end-to-end encrypted, the web app manages your profile and signed-in devices, and the database is backed up every night.

form_fields.label: Public base URL of this instance
form_fields.hint: The address browsers will reach, WITHOUT a trailing slash. Firefox reads this from the server and refuses to sign in over plain HTTP unless it is a loopback address. On Runtipi use your Traefik domain, e.g. https://foxden.tipi.lan. Firefox for Android and iOS require HTTPS.

form_fields.label: Trusted proxy (Traefik address) — leave empty to trust private addresses
form_fields.hint: Foxden rate-limits per client IP and trusts X-Forwarded-For from private/loopback addresses by default, which covers Runtipi's Traefik. Set this to the Traefik container's address only if the proxy is not on a private network. Format: an IP, a CIDR, a hop count, or the presets 'loopback', 'linklocal', 'uniquelocal'.

form_fields.label: SMTP host for invite emails (optional)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty to turn email off. Foxden then shows the invite link in the web app instead of mailing it. Example: smtp.example.com.

form_fields.label: SMTP port
form_fields.hint: 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for implicit TLS (also set the STARTTLS toggle off).

form_fields.label: SMTP username (optional)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty for a relay that accepts mail without signing in.

form_fields.label: SMTP password (optional)
form_fields.hint: Only used when the SMTP host is set.

form_fields.label: Sender address
form_fields.hint: The From address of the invite and password-reset emails.

form_fields.label: Use implicit TLS on the SMTP connection (port 465)
form_fields.hint: Off for port 587 (STARTTLS), on for port 465.

form_fields.label: Number of nightly database backups to keep
form_fields.hint: Foxden backs up its SQLite database every night into /data/backups and keeps this many copies. The backups hold password hashes and keys — copy them off the server.
